description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 music video prompt with attached video evidence from @ou_zhen599.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3音乐视频提示词。

prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A 15-second, 16:9, cinematic photoreal image-to-video sequence based on <Picture 1>, unfolding entirely inside the same tropical ruin space: wet stone foreground, shallow jungle stream, mossy carved path, and the ancient temple doorway hidden behind the waterfall on one continuous depth axis. Preserve the exact same adult female explorer throughout: same face, proportions, wet hairstyle, skin texture, backpack, wristband, boots, handgun, and overall silhouette. No scene jump, no second location, no giant chamber reveal, no extra people, no extra props, no black screen. The mood is elegant, dangerous, sensual, and restrained. Her sensuality comes only from wet skin, collarbone, shoulder strap, breathing, body control, and threat awareness, never posing. She remains in motion throughout. The camera has a pseudo-one-take feel with hidden transitions only through reeds, vines, the handgun, or her body wiping frame. Lighting is humid tropical daylight under broken canopy, mostly side-backlight and rim-backlight, with warm-green jungle reflections and cold white waterfall bounce. The temple doorway remains a black light-eating void until the final two seconds. [Shot 2] At 00:00.000-00:02.000, begin immediately on her in motion with an 84-degree close wide-angle shot attached near her left-front at collarbone height, retreating smoothly as she moves through shallow water. The frame clearly shows wet collarbone, tight shoulder strap on wet skin, damp hair clinging to the neck, slight chest rise from controlled breathing, her right hand holding the handgun low, and her legs crossing the water. She never stops. With her left hand she brushes one wet strand from her neck back behind the ear. This opening feels sensual inside action: collarbone, strap tension, breath, wet hair on skin, and controlled forward movement. Expression layer one is calm reconnaissance: brows mostly level with a slight inward pull, eyes sweep the ground and lift forward, upper lids slightly lowered, pupils steady, lips parted by a thin line, breath short and controlled. She says softly: <d>[English] Too quiet.</d> [Shot 3] At 00:02.000, without a hard cut, use her arm and foreground vines as a natural wipe into a left-rear three-quarter medium-close follow shot. Carved pillars and hanging vines brush the foreground repeatedly. She lowers her body and threads between two carved pillars without stopping, sweeping vines aside with her left hand while the handgun remains low but ready in her right. Her emotion shifts into slight doubt: the brow center gathers a little more, her gaze cuts from the stone path and pillar bases toward the waterfall, the upper lids lift by a fraction, nostrils widen slightly, breathing becomes faster but still controlled, the lip line grows flatter, and the jaw begins to set. Wet hair swings lightly with movement and leaf contact. Leaves rebound and shed tiny backlit droplets. [Shot 4] At 00:05.000, shift to a natural perspective from her right-rear at waist height, about 1.5 meters back. She steps onto an ancient carved stone pattern beneath shallow water. The surface water trembles first, then a muted antique gold-cold light briefly appears in the wet grooves and travels along the carved channels for about half a meter before fading. This must feel like an ancient stone surface being awakened, not electricity or neon. She reacts with real weight and inertia: front foot plants, rear foot searches for support, knees bend, pelvis stabilizes, torso half-turns, and the handgun rises fast from thigh level to chest-ready. Expression layer three is instant alertness: eyes snap into harder focus, the brow center draws inward sharply but briefly, eyelids open slightly, nostrils take one quick intake, lips part for an instant then seal, jaw locks. Wet hair swings and settles against the face again. Shallow water splashes outward, and the fading groove-light throws broken reflections across wet stone before vanishing. [Shot 5] At 00:08.000, the camera tracks laterally along her right side in a medium-close profile, keeping her and the waterfall-dark doorway on the same perspective line. She does not stop. She shifts two steps to the right along the stone edge, her left hand grazing the damp carved wall to confirm path and distance, while the handgun rises and locks toward the darkness behind the waterfall. Emotion layer four is hunter compression: her gaze nails the opening completely, blink rate drops, upper lids tighten, lower lids engage slightly, pupils stay fixed toward the void, brow center stays inward without lifting, nostrils hold tension, lips seal, mouth corners angle slightly downward, and the jaw hardens. One tiny swallow passes through the throat. The waterfall spray becomes dense white particles in backlight. The opening remains only a deep black layered void. No full animal form, no face, no human silhouette, no full panther head. [Shot 6] At 00:11.000, move into a pressure push-in from a half-body armed medium close toward a tight shot containing her eyes, handgun muzzle, shoulder line, and part of the collarbone, while preserving waterfall highlights and mist behind. She drives her rear foot into the stone, lowers her center of gravity, and aligns the gun more precisely toward the center of the dark opening, as if compressing herself into the aim line. Emotion layer five reaches maximum alertness: eyes sharp and nearly unblinking, brow slightly lowered inward, nostril tension increases, lips compress into a thinner line, jaw and masseter fully engage. The handgun must feel heavy in the wrist, forearm, and shoulder. Wet highlights on skin and metal flicker once and settle. Damp hair gives one last delayed sway and rests against the skin again. No dialogue here. [Shot 7] At 00:13.000, stop the push and hold a stable suspended composition. Foreground keeps only her three-quarter side-face silhouette and the handgun muzzle; the waterfall remains midground and the black opening remains background. In these last two seconds, introduce only one new piece of information: at first the opening contains nothing readable, then only one black panther eye catches a trace of ambient light and returns a muted amber-gold reflection. The eye must not glow actively and must not feel sci-fi or jewel-like. It is simply a living predator’s eye reflecting light inside extreme darkness. The panther body stays hidden. No full face, no full head, no visible nose bridge, no second eye, no leap, no sudden movement. Only the faintest wet black contour may barely touch the darkness edge. Water mist and spray continue to drift, deepening the doorway’s darkness. End on the suspended relationship: she has locked onto the void, and the void is looking back.

overall_soundscape: Use only realistic environmental and action sound. In the first half: shallow water footsteps, leaves brushing skin and clothing, controlled breathing, fabric and strap friction, slight handgun metal contact, and the low broad rush of the waterfall. At 00:00.000-00:02.000, emphasize close breath, water ripples, and the tactile slip of wet hair and strap movement under <d>[English] Too quiet.</d> At 00:02.000-00:05.000, bring in vine displacement, droplets flicked from leaves, gear movement, and tighter breathing. At 00:05.000-00:08.000, add wet boot contact on carved stone, a faint mineral-hum undertone as the groove-light activates, and the braking splash of her stop. At 00:08.000-00:13.000, let the waterfall rumble grow denser while her breath becomes quieter and more compressed. In the final two seconds, no growl is needed; let only waterfall, mist, and suspended pressure support the reflected eye.

non_diegetic_music: Use no score or only an extremely low, almost subliminal pressure bed beginning after the carved-stone anomaly. It must never overpower water, breath, leaves, or the final reveal. The ending should remain elegant, tense, wet, and unresolved rather than explosive or dramatic.
